C1210.title: Jack Dorsey's Twitter Account Hijacked via SIM Swap Attack
C1210.summary: BBC reporting and an August 2019 Twitter statement confirmed that then-CEO Jack Dorsey's account was compromised because of a phone-number security issue associated with a mobile provider. Attackers used the controlled number to post offensive content by text message before Twitter restored the account. The incident showed how dependence on carrier numbers and SMS posting can expose a high-profile account to number-takeover risks.
